Captured 2026-10-10 on this machine, from the test author's own shell, by:

    printf '[misc]\n' > /var/folders/.../opencode/control.toml
    topgrade --config /var/folders/.../opencode/control.toml --run-type dry

topgrade 17.12.3. `--run-type dry` executes no step: topgrade prints each
command instead of running it, which is what the "Dry running:" prefix on the
second line records. The config is intentionally EMPTY - no `disable` list -
because the whole point of this capture is what topgrade does with nothing
configured.

Transcribed verbatim from that run. Nothing here was produced by running the
suite, and the suite never runs topgrade: see tests/safety.bats for why.
